implementation.learningInput: Current learning_module with p IDs plus up to 50 chronological human/bot records with m IDs.
implementation.learningMode: Always thinking enabled, high by default, no web tools or image reads.
implementation.learningRetention: Unchanged prior rules can cite p IDs even without recent repetition. New or materially changed rules require current human m evidence.
implementation.teachingExample: Understand and restate search results naturally while preserving necessary source citations and uncertainty; reject fabrication or blanket deletion of sources.
implementation.scope: Default fixed persona for all members; no catalog, custom persona commands or selection cache. Existing group learning files retain their schema.

evidenceLimit: This source review is an engineering judgment, not human community ratings or a statistical prompt benchmark. Runtime validation is recorded separately.

followupChanges.preferences: User prioritizes lively QQ conversation, including playful nonsense; human echoes and all lengths allowed; own replies must not repeat. Prefers short and generally lazy typing as a non-mandatory tendency.
followupChanges.adaptation: Condensed native QQ whale card; removed duplicate persona and broad expression/factual restrictions; broad draft review off. Local exact own-reply guard remains enabled; semantic review is disabled by default after repeatedly rejecting a legitimate follow-up. Prompt guidance discourages repeating one's own meaning or joke without suppressing normal follow-ups.
followupChanges.learning: Existing module + chronological records; thinking high and 8192 budget; explicit reasonable teaching can be learned once. No blanket prohibition of human echoes or long sentences.
followupChanges.evaluation: Full continuous 100-message simulations and frozen-history A/B, with subjective Codex review. Earlier accuracy-oriented ratings are archived and not used as the final casual-chat criterion.
followupChanges.participation: Explicit active interest in whole public discussion, including 2-3 humans talking without bot intent. Reply-method learning no longer gates interest. Serial accumulation retains later messages, and continuous traffic cannot indefinitely postpone judging.
